annotations.title: Create XRechnung, ZUGFeRD or Factur-X e-invoice from JSON

description: Create an EU e-invoice from plain JSON: seller, buyer, lines with quantity, price and VAT rate, bank account. Returns XRechnung 3.0 XML (CII or UBL), a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF with the XML inside, its XML alone, or EN 16931 UBL. Totals and VAT breakdown are computed and checked against the business rules first; data that breaks a rule is refused uncharged with the rule numbers. Use to issue German B2B e-invoices from a shop, ERP or workflow. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

format.description: xrechnung (default: XRechnung 3.0, CII syntax), xrechnung-ubl, zugferd-pdf (a readable A4 invoice as PDF/A-3 with the factur-x.xml embedded, returned as pdfBase64), zugferd (that factur-x.xml alone, EN 16931 profile) or ubl (EN 16931 UBL)

invoice.description: The invoice as JSON: number, issueDate, dueDate, buyerReference (Leitweg-ID or order reference), seller and buyer {name, vatId, street, postCode, city, country, contactName, phone, email}, lines [{name, quantity, unit, unitPrice, vatRate}], payment {iban, bic, terms}. In a POST body send it as a JSON object. The flat fields /document/extract returns (invoice_number, seller_name, line_items…) are read too

language.description: Language of the labels on a zugferd-pdf page: de or en (default: de when the seller is in Germany or Austria, otherwise en)
